review: I see no difficulty curve, only a sawtooth. First Steps is a fair opener, but my mid-skill run stood in front of a double spike for 45 seconds. Spike Garden is broken: 0% mid-skill pass and even the expert gave up, at stage 2. Saw Mill and Ferry Lines test moving saws and ferries at 27% and 13% before they teach them. Crumble Bridge and Spring Loaded are the only well-tuned stages, with readable hazards and one clear idea each. Laser Gate kills at 2 seconds with no safe first gate. Gauntlet mixes all mechanics, but 10% pass and a stuck expert make it a wall.
best: Spring Loaded and Crumble Bridge each teach one mechanic clearly and land in the target pass band.
worst: Spike Garden at stage 2 cannot be finished by any of the three recorded players, which blocks the whole game.
